Federal Real Property Public Data Set
Federal Real Property Public Data Set
Access the 2025 FRPP public data set:
Civilian agencies - detailed asset level data
Department of War & Civilian agencies - summarized data
We need your help. Please tell us how you use this data and how it could be improved by sending an email to
publicfrppdata@gsa.gov
.
Data Limitations
The Federal Asset Sale and Transfer Act of 2016 authorizes the exclusion of real property from publication for reasons of national security and Freedom of Information Act exemptions. Decisions regarding which properties to exclude based on FOIA and national security determinations were made by individual federal agencies.
For the assets excluded under FOIA, the detailed data set file shows only the agency name, the FOIA exemption, and, if applicable, the statutory citation. In addition, the FRPP map only includes U.S. Department of State and the U.S. Agency for International Development properties that are in the United States.
People seeking to use the FRPP public data set should be aware that the data provided through this site reflects the current inventories of executive branch agencies as of September 30 of each fiscal year.
Background
The Federal Real Property Profile Management System is the federal government’s centralized inventory of real property under the custody and control of executive branch agencies. The public FRPP data accessible here is an extract from FRPP MS that has been accessible to the public since December 15, 2017.  The most recent edition of FRPP data currently accessible on this site represents the government’s inventory at the end of fiscal year  2025. Archived public data for FYs 2024 through 2016 are also available.
Agencies submit descriptive information on the nature, extent, and use of their real property assets to FRPP MS annually according to guidance outlined in the Federal Real Property Council Guidance for Real Property Inventory Reporting, also known as the FRPP data dictionary. The FRPP data dictionary defines the data elements and technical requirements for submitting data to FRPP MS and is available at
gsa.gov/datadictionary
.

Traveler reimbursement is based on the location of the work activities and not the accommodations,
                unless lodging is not available at the work activity, then the agency may authorize the rate where
                lodging is obtained.
Unless otherwise specified, the per diem locality is defined as
"all locations within, or entirely
                  surrounded by, the corporate limits of the key city, including independent entities located within
                  those boundaries."
Per diem localities with county definitions shall include
"all locations within, or entirely
                  surrounded by, the corporate limits of the key city as well as the boundaries of the listed counties,
                  including independent entities located within the boundaries of the key city and the listed counties
                  (unless otherwise listed separately)."
When a military installation or Government - related facility(whether or not specifically named) is
                located partially within more than one city or county boundary, the applicable per diem rate for the
                entire installation or facility is the higher of the rates which apply to the cities and / or counties,
                even though part(s) of such activities may be located outside the defined per diem locality.

Assets on a campus or installation may share one main address or identical Lat/Long coordinates and appear stacked visually, but each remains a unique GIS feature. Traveler reimbursement is based on the location of the work activities and not the accommodations,
                unless lodging is not available at the work activity, then the agency may authorize the rate where
                lodging is obtained.
Unless otherwise specified, the per diem locality is defined as
"all locations within, or entirely
                  surrounded by, the corporate limits of the key city, including independent entities located within
                  those boundaries."
Per diem localities with county definitions shall include
"all locations within, or entirely
                  surrounded by, the corporate limits of the key city as well as the boundaries of the listed counties,
                  including independent entities located within the boundaries of the key city and the listed counties
                  (unless otherwise listed separately)."
When a military installation or Government - related facility(whether or not specifically named) is
                located partially within more than one city or county boundary, the applicable per diem rate for the
                entire installation or facility is the higher of the rates which apply to the cities and / or counties,
                even though part(s) of such activities may be located outside the defined per diem locality.
